reply: Built, not merged. The git mailbox is PR #1371: send, read and take between cloud sessions and your computers, through the private repo shivinate7/session-mailbox. It passed review round 3 on Nov 6 and has sat as an idle draft since, never batched. I told the coordinator now. Models: any session can use it, whatever its model. Accounts: a session under another GitHub account needs access to that private repo; no step covers that yet. Triage, 21:31 CST.
